text:
maya: Heads-up — nightly perf CI flagged a ~18% p95 regression on the small-batch benchmark for model xg-7b-quant. I left the raw artifact link in the job, but copying a tiny excerpt below. Can someone triage? :eyes:

ci-bot: [ALERT] nightly-bench/17688 — p95 +18% vs baseline (sha: d4f7a2c). Artifact: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/artifacts/17688

zach: Thanks — can you paste the bench args and the run id? Also, did the host allocation change (GPU type/driver)?

maya: run id 17688-enc1, bench args: `--model xg-7b-quant --batch 4 --seq 512 --iters 40 --warmup 5`
Host is gtx-a100-80g, same as baseline. Kernel driver unchanged per infra tags.

liam: quick ask — is this consistent across quant levels? Any difference with unquantized run?

maya: unquantized ran earlier with no regression (p95 stable). This spike only shows up on the quantized build.

olivia: pinging infra: @zach any recent kernel/rdma patches landed to the A100 fleet in the last 48h?

zach: infra notes: rolled gpu driver 510.85 -> 511.12 two days ago but can confirm which pools got it. I'll check allocation logs.

liam: can we reproduce locally? maya, can you paste the exact docker image tag and the command you used?

maya: image: ghcr.redwood/bench:2026-03-16-d4f7a2c
Command:
```
./run_bench.sh --model xg-7b-quant --batch 4 --seq 512 --iters 40 --warmup 5 --pin-kernel
```
Logs: `p95=243ms -> baseline 206ms` (attached to artifact).

olivia: proposed next steps: 1) dev reproduce w/ same image + host, 2) bisect between quant commit and previous good commit, 3) if repro, run nvprof + perf sampling. Who's happy to pick step 1?

zach: I can repro on a spare node, starting now. Will report back with perf counters.

liam: if repro, let's capture KV cache traces and timing breakouts per op (attn, matmul, softmax). maya — can you add a small profile flag to the run that emits op-level timings?

maya: done — requeued artifact with `--op-timings` as job 17688-enc1-profiles. Link posted in the job.

ci-bot: [JOB UPDATE] 17688-enc1-profiles completed. Output: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/artifacts/17688-profiles

zach: early look — matmul kernels show +22% time. nvprof shows a new cuda kernel name suffix (maybe from the quantized path). dumping kernel list now.

liam: okay that narrows it. Could be a codegen/kernelselector change in the quant path. I'm going to grep the quant dispatch PRs between d4f7a2c and previous. If I find a suspect, will open a quick revertable PR.

olivia: if you don't find it in 30m, handoff plan: leave an ops note and mark for morning on-call (tagging @oncall-runtime). For now, set a temporary autoscale throttle to avoid customer-facing regressions for dedicated pools running xg-7b-quant.

maya: noted. leaving the thread for now — thanks everyone. I'll add links to the bisect plan in the job. :pray
